seoDescription: The second brain algorithm: a Whistleblower Lab project case file.

sections.heading: THE MASTERMIND
sections.body: Every other [cyan: sb-proj-*] repository is a code satellite: the RTL, tests and bitstreams of one project. This one holds no code. It holds the [yellow: knowledge]: every project's status, every reusable module, every hard-won bug fix, every architecture decision, each linking out to the code it describes.

items.label: subtitle
items.value: SECOND BRAIN · THE HUB OF ALL THINGS

items.label: bubble
items.value: It is the hub. The code repos are the spokes.

images.alt: Comic cover: a chained figure whose brain is lifted out by two hands

sections.heading: PANEL 1 · THE CONSTELLATION
sections.body: One manifest knows every repo in the org: 1 control plane, 2 index stores, 22 satellites, each with its branch, release and head SHA. Pulses travel the links it records.

items.label: PROJECTS
items.detail: Status, maturity, tools, metrics, and a link to the code satellite.

items.label: MODULES
items.detail: Reusable VHDL entities: ports, status, dependencies.

items.label: ERRORS
items.detail: GHDL / Vivado failure patterns: symptom, fix, diagnosis.

items.label: DECISIONS
items.detail: Architecture Decision Records, dated and reasoned.

sections.heading: PANEL 2 · IT REMEMBERS EVERY MISTAKE
sections.body: The largest folder is [yellow: errors/]: 137 recorded GHDL and Vivado failure patterns, each with the symptom, the fix and how it was found. This isn't a portfolio; it's an engineering memory whose biggest asset is the catalogue of mistakes already made.

images.alt: Stippled drawing of a face staring up at a sky full of floating eyes above a city of blocks

sections.heading: PANEL 3 · ANATOMY OF A PROJECT RECORD
sections.body:
[gray: ---  # frontmatter, projects/*.md]
[magenta: satellite]:  [cyan: code repo URL]
[magenta: commit]:     [cyan: exact SHA it was written against]
[magenta: maturity]:   Prototype
[magenta: status]:     paused | active
[magenta: tools]:      [...]
[magenta: metrics]:
  - value: ...
    [green: provenance]: simulated | synthesized | measured
[gray: ---]

items.label: note
items.value: shape as described in EXPLAINER.md, not a copied record

items.label: PROVENANCE > OPINION
items.detail: The hub doesn't just say "3 scenarios passing". It says how that was established. Honesty about where a number came from is a schema field, not a habit.

items.label: PINNED TO A COMMIT
items.detail: Each record names its code repo and the exact commit, so knowledge and code can be diffed instead of silently drifting apart.

sections.heading: PANEL 4 · REBUILD FROM NOTHING
sections.body: RESUME-ON-NEW-DEVICE.md and bootstrap.sh bring the vault, retrieval engine, tools and multi-GB corpus back on an empty computer: about 30 minutes hands-on plus an unattended download.

items.label: note
items.value: ADR-006: restore data, don't regenerate it.
